svg.text: Study all skills together or one at a time.
Paraphrase, scanning, main idea, gap filling and True / False / Not
Complete "Scanning for details" to open this lesson.
Getting to know True / False / Not Given
Complete "Main idea and gap filling" to open this lesson.
Unlock the skill to take the topic test.
Tell FALSE from NOT GIVEN; handle words such as most, all, only.
Pass the final test of "Reading foundations" to unlock.
Choose a heading for each paragraph from its main idea.
Pass the final test of "True / False / Not Given skills" to unlock.
Opens after all 3 stages (now 0/3). Pass mark 70%.
